import awkward as ak
from pocket_coffea.lib.processing import BaseProcessor

class DimuonAnalysisProcessor(BaseProcessor):
    """Minimal dimuon analysis processor for PocketCoffea."""
    
    def process_objects(self, events):
        """Object preselection: build MuonGood collection."""
        muon_mask = (events.Muon.pt > 15) & (ak.abs(events.Muon.eta) < 2.4)
        events["MuonGood"] = events.Muon[muon_mask]
        return events
    
    def count_objects(self, events):
        """Object counting: store number of selected muons per event."""
        events["nMuonGood"] = ak.num(events.MuonGood)
        return events

import awkward as ak
from pocket_coffea.lib.processing import BaseProcessor

class DimuonAnalysisProcessor(BaseProcessor):
    """Minimal dimuon analysis processor for PocketCoffea."""
    
    def process_objects(self, events):
        """Object preselection: build MuonGood collection."""
        muon_mask = (events.Muon.pt > 15) & (ak.abs(events.Muon.eta) < 2.4)
        events["MuonGood"] = events.Muon[muon_mask]
        return events
    
    def count_objects(self, events):
        """Object counting: store number of selected muons per event."""
        events["nMuonGood"] = ak.num(events.MuonGood)
        return events
